Material object in Teamcenter. Used as a base unit to store the substances along with their compositions. This object is used in many applications like Integrated Materials Management, Substance Compliance, IMDS Integration, and managed CAD applications like NX. Once created, it is reused as a part of a library and typically is never deleted. This object can be created from Teamcenter or it can also be created as part of the sourcing or integration operations part of the consuming applications. Some of the examples of such operations are MATML import, IPC import, IMDS import, NX Integration.

ServiceInterface.description: The Material Management service exposes operations that are used to query material and substance related information associated with a part. Substances can be defined as basic forms of matter that cannot be disintegrated further using some mechanical or physical process, e.g. iron. Substances have Chemical Abstracts Service registry numbers to uniquely identify them. Material is defined as matter composed of several substances, e.g. iron, carbon, cadmium, etc. with definite or variable compositions. A Teamcenter part can be made of several materials, e.g. Steel Alloy 440, Cast Iron 2300 Series, etc. with definite masses of materials. The queries data is a set of Mat1MaterialInfo objects that contains the material reference with the mass in a unit of measure (UoM) related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects and a set of Mat1SubstanceInfo objects that contain the substance reference with the mass in a UoM related to ItemRevision objects or BOMLine objects.
ServiceInterface.name: MaterialManagement

OperationTemplate.description: Method to query material and substance related information associated with a part. Substances can be defined as basic form of matter which cannot be disintegrated further using some mechanical or physical process, e.g. iron. Substances have a Chemical Abstracts Service registry number to uniquely identify them. Material is defined as matter composed of several substances, e.g. iron, carbon, cadmium etc. with definite or variable compositions. A Teamcenter part can be made of several materials, e.g. Steel Alloy 440, Cast Iron 2300 Series, etc. The query data is a set of Mat1MaterialInfo objects that contain material references with their mass in a unit of measure (UoM) related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects, and a set of Mat1SubstanceInfo objects that contain substance references with their mass in UoM related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects.
OperationTemplate.name: Mat1::Soa::MaterialManagement::MaterialManagement::getMaterialSubstanceInfo
OperationTemplate.returnDescription: Response that contains set of Mat1MaterialInfo objects, a set of Mat1SubstanceInfo objects related to ItemRevision objects or BOMLine objects, and service data. The Mat1MaterialInfo object contains material reference with the mass in a UoM related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects. The Mat1SubstanceInfo object contains substance reference with the mass in a UoM related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects.

OperationParameter.name: objs

OperationTemplate.description:
Exports one of the following
1. Instances of input Mat1MaterialRevision & its' decendent classes and its parameters in the provided format which belongs to same belonging Mat1MatCatalogRevision. One or more instances Mat1MaterialRevision or its' decendent classes is expected.
2. Instances of Mat1MaterialRevision & its' decendent classes and its parameters in the provided format belonging to input Mat1MatCatalogRevision. Only one instance of Mat1MatCatalogRevision is expected in input.
3. Instances of input Mat1MaterialClassification & all Mat1MaterialClassification objects pointing to input object. One or more instances of Mat1MaterialClassification class is expected.

ImportExportOptions play an important role in the way Mat1MaterialRevision objects are exported.
OperationTemplate.name: Mat1::Soa::MaterialManagement::MaterialManagement::exportMaterialsData
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
List of fileTickets pointing to files in corresponding file-format as per given export options.

The following partial errors may be returned:
1. 108057 No materials are provided for the export operation.
2. 108058 Invalid object(s) passed as input to export operation. Please read the operation description for list of valid input objects.
3. 108059 Invalid exportType provided for the export operation. Valid values are values available in preference IMM_EXPORT_FILTERS.
4. 108060 Material objects belong to different Mat1MatCatalogRevision object. Only material objects belonging to same Mat1MatCatalogRevision are allowed during export.
5. 108061 Only one instance of Mat1MatCatalogRevision is expected as input.

OperationParameter.description: List of ExportMaterialsDataIn objects. Each structure contains list of Mat1MaterialRevision objects & corresponding export options. If mutiple objects are to be exported in different export formats, each export format should have one ExportMaterialsDataIn object.
OperationParameter.name: input

OperationTemplate.description:
Import one of the following
1. Materials and its parameters from given list of files in specified file format.
2. Material classes and its heirarchy.

ImportExportOptions also play an important role in determining the way Materials are imported.
OperationTemplate.name: Mat1::Soa::MaterialManagement::MaterialManagement::importMaterialsData
OperationTemplate.returnDescription:
List of fileTickets containg summary of import operation for given list of files.

The following partial errors may be returned:
1. 108051 Invalid importType provided for the import operation. Valid values are values available in preference IMM_IMPORT_FILTERS.
2. 108052 Invalid file ticket(s) passed to import operation.
3. 108053 Invalid object passed as materialCatalog to import operation. Only object of class Mat1MatCatalogRevision and its' decendent classes are allowed.
4. 108054 Invalid materialType provided for the import operation. Valid values are Mat1Material and its' descendent classes.
5. 108055 Invalid substanceType provided for the import operation. Valid values are Mat1Substance and its' descendent classes.
6. 108056 Invalid type of objects passed as input to import operation. Objects of class Mat1MaterialRevision and its' decendent classes are allowed.

Operation.description:
Exports one of the following
1. Instances of input Mat1MaterialRevision & its' decendent classes and its parameters in the provided format which belongs to same belonging Mat1MatCatalogRevision. One or more instances Mat1MaterialRevision or its' decendent classes is expected.
2. Instances of Mat1MaterialRevision & its' decendent classes and its parameters in the provided format belonging to input Mat1MatCatalogRevision. Only one instance of Mat1MatCatalogRevision is expected in input.
3. Instances of input Mat1MaterialClassification & all Mat1MaterialClassification objects pointing to input object. One or more instances of Mat1MaterialClassification class is expected.

ImportExportOptions play an important role in the way Mat1MaterialRevision objects are exported.
Operation.name: exportMaterialsData
Operation.returnDescription:
List of fileTickets pointing to files in corresponding file-format as per given export options.

The following partial errors may be returned:
1. 108057 No materials are provided for the export operation.
2. 108058 Invalid object(s) passed as input to export operation. Please read the operation description for list of valid input objects.
3. 108059 Invalid exportType provided for the export operation. Valid values are values available in preference IMM_EXPORT_FILTERS.
4. 108060 Material objects belong to different Mat1MatCatalogRevision object. Only material objects belonging to same Mat1MatCatalogRevision are allowed during export.
5. 108061 Only one instance of Mat1MatCatalogRevision is expected as input.

ParameterInfo.description: List of ExportMaterialsDataIn objects. Each structure contains list of Mat1MaterialRevision objects & corresponding export options. If mutiple objects are to be exported in different export formats, each export format should have one ExportMaterialsDataIn object.

Operation.description: Method to query material and substance related information associated with a part. Substances can be defined as basic form of matter which cannot be disintegrated further using some mechanical or physical process, e.g. iron. Substances have a Chemical Abstracts Service registry number to uniquely identify them. Material is defined as matter composed of several substances, e.g. iron, carbon, cadmium etc. with definite or variable compositions. A Teamcenter part can be made of several materials, e.g. Steel Alloy 440, Cast Iron 2300 Series, etc. The query data is a set of Mat1MaterialInfo objects that contain material references with their mass in a unit of measure (UoM) related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects, and a set of Mat1SubstanceInfo objects that contain substance references with their mass in UoM related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects.
Operation.name: getMaterialSubstanceInfo
Operation.returnDescription: Response that contains set of Mat1MaterialInfo objects, a set of Mat1SubstanceInfo objects related to ItemRevision objects or BOMLine objects, and service data. The Mat1MaterialInfo object contains material reference with the mass in a UoM related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects. The Mat1SubstanceInfo object contains substance reference with the mass in a UoM related to ItemRevision or BOMLine objects.

ParameterInfo.description: References of ItemRevision objectss or BOMLine objects for which material and substance information is sought.

Operation.description:
Import one of the following
1. Materials and its parameters from given list of files in specified file format.

ImportExportOptions also play an important role in determining the way Materials are imported.
